checks.name: Occurrence, recognition and reporting-month cohorts remain distinct
Mixed currencies, unaccepted records and pending corrections never pollute financial totals
Cash inflows and approved reversals use their own date window and preserve historical receipts
Age, concentration and date-basis charts reconcile including partial reporting-month windows
Source account classifications, loss groups and risk categories are not conflated
Recovery estimates and reporting discrepancies remain visible without changing booked balances
Repeated-period rows are flagged as candidates and never silently deduplicated
Explicit scopes remain precise, and invalid periods, dates or currencies fail closed
All reporting lenses and empty states render through the actual source functions
New board annexes are immutable and old report packs gain no live-data annex
Cohort and receipt exports preserve dates, separate currencies, original account fields and reversal identity
Near misses are not applicable to financial recognition and are not reported as missing dates
Combined management read models reconcile reviewed NGN totals and exclude foreign and unaccepted records
Loss trend and adjacent comparison offsets are days and partition every supported period exactly once
Risk monetary summaries use reviewed NGN while linked rows preserve state and original currencies
Copilot follows the visible loss currency, date basis, search and workflow filters with stable context hashes
Published annex explanations use captured figures and old packs gain no live financial context
Legacy detail entry points reach scoped workspaces and all new report controls remain wired
